{{Quote|A ship has to be specially insulated to drop down through an area where an energy drill is working. By-products, including excess charges, are shunted away skyward. But the fallout materials&mdash;if this world supports a native race, it's illegal, that kind of mining.|Princess Leia Organa|<ref name="Splinter of the Mind's Eye">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref>}}
An '''energy drill''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] tool that fired [[plasma]] bolts to disintegrate a target area in a process known as [[Energy mining/Legends|energy mining]]. The use of an energy drill caused excess charges to be launched skyward. Any vehicle not specially insulated that passed through the area suffered catastrophic damage and equipment failure. Because of the fallout and byproducts of energy drilling, it was forbidden by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] law on any [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with a native population. The Empire was known to violate this law in secret, as they did on [[Mimban/Legends|Mimban]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]] [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] crashed on Mimban when their [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] malfunctioned due to the fallout from an Imperial energy drill.
